claims.disproof_condition: 條件：KSH 的季報或年報寫出出口營收轉為年減，或擴產完成後特殊線材利用率連兩季低於 60%。核查頻率：每季（NSE 季報與投資人簡報）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註，重讀 CTC 層的量與窗口。
claims.statement: KSH International's own investor presentation (NSE, 2026-05-26): its products include Continuously Transposed Conductors; specialised magnet winding wires are 75.3% of revenue; it is the 'largest Indian exporter of winding wires to 24 countries including Middle East, Europe and USA' with ~30% of revenue from exports; it serves 120+ OEMs including Hitachi Energy, GE Vernova and Siemens Energy; capacity is being expanded from 29,045 MT (FY25) to 59,045 MT by March 2027 (43,445 MT annualized at 2026-03-31), while FY26 capacity utilisation was 64.8% (down from 80.3% in FY25). Supplier self-report: no CTC-only revenue, no U.S. share, no named U.S. customer — the U.S. LPT customers come from the customs records, not from this deck.
